name: abl_attn_pool_km
description: v5b residue attention-pool (RankBind's best BRENDA-200 config, MRR 0.427) transferred to the BRENDA+SABIO Km decoy-augmented dataset (~9.5k UniProts, the largest of the three). Tests whether the BEST model generalises beyond BRENDA-200, not just the v4 mean-pool recipe. Model block copied verbatim from abl_attn_pool.json (learned single-head attention pool over per-residue ESM2 + bilinear head rank=128); data block inherited from datasets/km_with_decoys.json. hard_pool_size scaled to 3400 (~50% of train proteins), matching the v4 km sweep peak in paper Table tab:hpsweep.

_notes.role: km-scale generalisation test of the v5b attn_pool head (best model). Largest dataset (~9.5k proteins) -> needs 12h walltime. Single-seed (42) like the v4 transfer runs.
_notes.hard_pool_size_rationale: 3400 ~= 50% of the km train-protein pool; mirrors the v4 sweep peak for this dataset (paper Table tab:hpsweep).
